facts.business: KETO Motors Limited (formerly TAAZA International Limited) is a company that underwent NCLT-approved resolution plan implementation and restructuring during FY 2025-26.

auditor.name: BOPPUDI & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Implementation of the NCLT-approved Resolution Plan and consequential restructuring of the Company

key_risks: Credit risk from trade receivables and dealers/customers
Liquidity risk managed through reserves and credit lines
Interest rate risk from floating-rate borrowings linked to repo-linked lending rate/MCLR
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis; details disclosed in Notes to Financial Statements and Form AOC-2 (Annexure 2). Policy on materiality of RPTs available at www.ketomotors.com/Investors.html.
